stages.name: cold head / integrated process heat exchanger (single stage, N2 (re-)liquefaction mode)
stages.quote: The SPC-1 is a single stage Cryogenerator that provides cooling power in the range of 400 W to 2,7 kW at temperatures of 50-160 K.

sample_space.shape: process-gas heat exchanger integrated in the cold head; nitrogen vapour enters, is condensed on the cold heat exchanger and leaves as liquid (no sample stage).
sample_space.description: No sample space: the SPC-1 is a cryogenerator, not a cryostat. The 'load' is the process gas (N2 boil-off) flowing through the cold-head heat exchanger at up to 20 barg; the customer's LN2 bath / cable loop is external and not supplied.

notes: Scene: a floor-standing industrial Stirling cryogenerator box 1.0 m x 0.7 m x 1.65 m, 550 kg, not a cryostat. Datasheet SPC-1 (2026/01): single-stage reversed Stirling cycle, 400 W - 2.7 kW at 50-160 K, graph conditions 30 barg helium at 1455 rpm, water-cooled (1200 l/h, 20% glycol), 3-phase 400 V/50 Hz or 480 V/60 Hz, max process gas 20 barg, < 72 dBA, > 8000 h maintenance interval. Catalog capability 400 W at 77/80 K comes from the net N2/O2 cooling-power curve. Product page: process heat exchanger integrated in the cold head; PLC controlled; all rotating/reciprocating seals at ambient temperature; units exist in 1- or 4-cylinder, single- or two-stage versions (the SPC-4 datasheet lists 2.5-11 kW, consistent with SPC-1 being the 1-cylinder unit, but the cylinder count is not printed for the SPC-1 so it is left in not_found). HTS leaflet: in re-liquefier mode the boil-off of the customer's LN2 (or LNe) bath flows to the cryogenerator and is condensed; LN2 sub-cooling to 68 K for cables uses external pumps and a pressurising vessel. Animation: crankshaft/pistons at 1455 rpm (24.25 Hz) in the ambient-temperature crankcase, helium shuttling to the cold head, N2 vapour entering and liquid dripping from the cold-head heat exchanger, water loop at 1200 l/h.
